note: Brook trout: the dorsal and anal fin outlines ARE traced, so the fin-base endpoint keypoints are redundant here and are NOT collected (excluded 2026-09-22; the 45-53 fish already carrying them keep those coordinates). DFbl and CPl derive those points from the polygons. The body+caudal outline is not collected either, and Auto-label does not offer it: SAM wraps the adipose and anal fins instead of crossing their bases. Landmarks are checked against the eye-to-caudal-base axis, which needs no outline.
